literal: What is worn and what is eaten, if sees upon others, fault to see capable becomes the base person.
translation: If a base person sees others well-dressed and well-fed, he becomes capable only of finding faults in them.
modern: பிறர் நல்ல உடைகளை உடுத்துவதையும் நல்ல உணவை உண்பதையும் கண்டால், அவர்கள் மேல் குற்றங்களை மட்டுமே காணும் இயல்புடையவன் கீழ்மகன்.
explanation: This couplet describes the deeply envious nature of base people. When they see others enjoying good food and clothing, they cannot tolerate their prosperity. Instead of feeling happy or remaining indifferent, their immediate reaction is to search for blemishes ('வடு') in those prosperous people. The words 'உடுப்பதூஉம்' and 'உண்பதூஉம்' use elongated vowels (aḷapeṭai) to emphasize the abundance and quality of what is worn and eaten by others, which triggers the base person's jealousy.
